content.text:
Send this from the **Chain** tab.

```
While a Code, Chain, or Spec task runs, the harness keeps a short list of the
constraints it has taken from the spec for this task, and
@{ReferencedSpecSidebarScope} shows it as it changes.

The understanding file. Each task has one, saved beside its history record
with the same name and the extension `.understanding.md`. @{ModeSystemPromptsScope}
gains an UNDERSTANDING_FILE placeholder, standing for that file's path from
the project directory, and the Code, Chain, and Spec default templates end
with:

"Before changing anything, write the constraints this task must meet to
UNDERSTANDING_FILE, and keep it current as you read more of the spec. It is a
Markdown list and nothing else: one line per constraint, at most twelve, each
a single short, specific statement of what must be true, written as a link to
the spec or reference file it comes from, such as
`- [The chain tab has no bottom border in combined mode](spec/scope/prompt-mode/chat-input/index.pi)`.
Only list what the spec says; leave out anything you are deciding yourself.
Replace a constraint when you learn it was wrong rather than adding another."

Questions from the Ask tab have no understanding file.

The split. The sidebar is split in two, one above the other: the referenced
files at the top, and "Understanding" at the bottom, with the same header
style, and how many constraints are listed, muted, at its right. The line
between them can be dragged to share the height between the two, each at
least 80 pixels tall; the split starts halfway and keeps where it was dragged
for as long as the application runs. Each half scrolls on its own with a
@{ScrollbarScope}.

The Understanding half shows the file as it is written: one row per
constraint, its text wrapping, and clicking it opens the file it links to, as
@{OpenFileScope} says. A link to a file that doesn't exist shows its text
muted and does nothing when clicked. It updates as the file changes on disk,
and a row that changes or is added is briefly highlighted. Until the file
exists it reads "Nothing understood yet", muted. Anything in the file that
isn't a list item is left out.
```

**Choices I made**
- **Only what the spec says:** assumptions are left out so every line links to a real source. That keeps the list short and checkable. If you want the gaps the agent fills in too, add: "Under a line reading `Assumed:`, at most three things the spec doesn't say that you're deciding, without links."
- **Twelve constraints at most,** and "replace rather than add", so the list stays a summary of the task and doesn't turn into a log.
- **File, not stream:** the agent writes a file, and the app watches it. That works with any harness that can edit files, and the list is kept with the task history.

**Worth adding if you want them**
- **Line links:** ask for `path#L42`-style links to the exact line, if `OpenFileScope` should jump to it.
- **After the run:** the sidebar disappears when the task ends. Add "A previous task in the history shows its understanding beneath its compiled prompt, collapsed" if you want to look back at it.
